nodes.title: START HERE
code:
V.SHMUP LITE
Joystick 2: move / fire.

The three opcode nodes below SYSTEM INIT are the startup spine. They bank out BASIC, then jump to BOOT / TITLE.

Every ordinary node contains ONE opcode. Open the collapsed ORGs to follow or edit each routine. Mapping boxes name the sections. GAME SETUP explicitly jumps to FRAME LOOP.

Existing macros provide bitmap, music, sprites, scrolling and HUD. No CODE blocks.

Assets: FRONT_END, TILES, ACTORS, WORLD, MUSIC_AND_SFX, STATUS.

ORG addresses leave space between routines. RAM $C000 holds game state.

This revision covers V.SHMUP LITE only.
